<!-- Keep this css code to improve the font quality-->
<style>
  * {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -o-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
</style>

<script>
// External script from source design: assets/gsap/gsap.min.js

// External script from source design: assets/gsap/ScrollTrigger.min.js

// External script from source design: assets/gsap/ScrollToPlugin.min.js

// External script from source design: assets/gsap/ScrollSmoother.min.js

// External script from source design: assets/gsap/SplitText.min.js

// External script from source design: assets/gsap/Observer.min.js

/* ==========================================================================
   BOOTSTRAP (the only shared script)
   Section scripts push their setup into WZ.add(). We create ScrollSmoother
   first, then flush the queue, so every ScrollTrigger measures against the
   final smoothed layout. Without this ordering, triggers registered mid-parse
   measure a half-built page.
   ========================================================================== */
window.WZ = (function(){
  var q = [], flushed = false;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var ok = !!(window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger);

  /* NOTE: plugins are deliberately NOT registered here. This script runs inside
     <head>, where document.body does not exist yet — registering ScrollTrigger
     that early leaves its internals half-initialised, and ScrollSmoother then
     dies on `getScrollFunc` with "Cannot read properties of undefined". The
     flush block at the end of <body> does the registration instead. */

  /* Split into masked lines, with graceful degradation if SplitText is absent. */
  function splitLines(el){
    if(!window.SplitText) return null;
    try{
      var opts = {type:'lines', mask:'lines', linesClass:'wz-line'};
      return (SplitText.create ? SplitText.create(el,opts) : new SplitText(el,opts));
    }catch(e){
      try{ return new SplitText(el,{type:'lines',linesClass:'wz-line'}); }catch(e2){ return null; }
    }
  }
  function splitWords(el){
    if(!window.SplitText) return null;
    try{
      var opts = {type:'words', wordsClass:'wz-word'};
      return (SplitText.create ? SplitText.create(el,opts) : new SplitText(el,opts));
    }catch(e){ return null; }
  }

  return {
    reduced: reduced,
    ok: ok,
    smoother: null,
    splitLines: splitLines,
    splitWords: splitWords,
    add: function(fn){ flushed ? this.run(fn) : q.push(fn); },
    run: function(fn){ try{ fn(this); }catch(e){ console.error('[WZ section]', e); } },
    flush: function(){
      flushed = true;
      var self = this;
      q.forEach(function(fn){ self.run(fn); });
      q.length = 0;
    }
  };
})();
</script>

<style>
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&family=Raleway:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap");
body{background:#0B0B0C;color:#fff;font-family:'Raleway','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(.975rem,1.05vw,1.0625rem);line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
body.is-locked.is-locked.is-locked{overflow:hidden}
.wz-ready.wz-ready.wz-ready [data-anim="hide"]{visibility:visible}
.site-nav.solid.solid.solid{background:rgba(11,11,12,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom-color:rgba(171,158,106,.22)}
.nav-mid i > .i-after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:#AB9E6A;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0));transform-origin:left}
.burger.open.open.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(3.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.burger.open.open.open span:nth-child(2){transform:translateY(-3.5px) rotate(-45deg)}
.drawer.open.open.open{clip-path:circle(150% at calc(100% - 42px) 42px)}
.drawer.open.open.open li a{transform:translateY(0)}
.ch-reality .big .wz-word.wz-word.wz-word{color:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.cmp .slide.on.on.on{opacity:1}
.cmp .aft{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 var(--pos,0%))}
.cmp .handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:var(--pos,0%);width:2px;background:#AB9E6A;transform:translateX(-1px);z-index:3;opacity:0}
.ch-transformation .dots i.on.on.on{background:#8A7E4E}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
*{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
* > .div-before{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
* > .div-after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}
[data-anim="hide"]{visibility:visible!important}
}
</style>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollToPlugin.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollSmoother.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/SplitText.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/Observer.min.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
/* ==========================================================================
   FLUSH — smoother first, then every section's queued setup, then refresh.
   ========================================================================== */
(function(){
  var W = window.WZ;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('wz-ready');

  if(!W || !W.ok){
    /* GSAP missing: reveal everything so the page is still readable. */
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-anim="hide"]').forEach(function(el){ el.style.visibility='visible'; });
    return;
  }

  /* Register here, not in <head> — body must exist before ScrollTrigger inits. */
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, ScrollToPlugin);
  if(window.ScrollSmoother) gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollSmoother);
  if(window.SplitText)      gsap.registerPlugin(SplitText);
  if(window.Observer)       gsap.registerPlugin(Observer);

  if(!W.reduced && window.ScrollSmoother){
    try{
      W.smoother = ScrollSmoother.create({
        wrapper:'#smooth-wrapper', content:'#smooth-content',
        smooth: 1.05, effects: false, smoothTouch: false, normalizeScroll: false
      });
    }catch(e){ console.warn('ScrollSmoother unavailable', e); }
  }

  W.flush();

  /* --- nav state: reading progress + chapter readout (global UI) --- */
  var navCh  = document.getElementById('navCh'),
      navNm  = document.getElementById('navName'),
      navBar = document.getElementById('navBar'),
      navPr  = document.getElementById('navProgress'),
      nav    = document.getElementById('nav');

  /* Whole-page reading progress along the top edge of the nav. */
  gsap.to(navPr,{scaleX:1,ease:'none',
    scrollTrigger:{start:0,end:'max',scrub:.25}});

  gsap.utils.toArray('section[data-chapter]').forEach(function(sec){
    var i = parseInt(sec.getAttribute('data-chapter'),10),
        name = sec.getAttribute('data-chapter-name');
    function activate(){
      if(navCh) navCh.textContent = String(i).padStart(2,'0');
      if(navNm) navNm.textContent = name;
      if(navBar) navBar.style.setProperty('--p', (i/8).toFixed(3));
    }
    ScrollTrigger.create({trigger:sec,start:'top 55%',end:'bottom 45%',
      onEnter:activate,onEnterBack:activate});
  });

  ScrollTrigger.create({start:40,end:99999,
    onToggle:function(self){ nav.classList.toggle('solid', self.isActive); }});

  /* --- anchors routed through the smoother so pinned sections land right --- */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if(id.length < 2) return;
      var t = document.querySelector(id);
      if(!t) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if(W.smoother) W.smoother.scrollTo(t, true, 'top top');
      else gsap.to(window,{duration: W.reduced?0:1, scrollTo:{y:t,autoKill:true},ease:'power2.inOut'});
    });
  });

  /* --- magnetic buttons, pointer-fine only --- */
  if(!W.reduced && window.matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches){
    document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic').forEach(function(el){
      var xTo = gsap.quickTo(el,'x',{duration:.5,ease:'power3'}),
          yTo = gsap.quickTo(el,'y',{duration:.5,ease:'power3'});
      el.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        xTo((e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)*.22); yTo((e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)*.38);
      });
      el.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(){ xTo(0); yTo(0); });
    });
  }

  /* --- mobile drawer --- */
  var burger = document.getElementById('burger'), drawer = document.getElementById('drawer');
  function closeDrawer(){
    burger.classList.remove('open'); drawer.classList.remove('open');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    document.body.classList.remove('is-locked');
    if(W.smoother) W.smoother.paused(false);
  }
  burger.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var open = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
    burger.classList.toggle('open',open);
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
    drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!open));
    burger.setAttribute('aria-label', open?'Close menu':'Open menu');
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-locked',open);
    if(W.smoother) W.smoother.paused(open);
  });
  drawer.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click',function(){ closeDrawer(); });
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape' && drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeDrawer();
  });

  /* Pinned sections measure wrong if fonts or images land late. */
  if(document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
})();
})();
</script>
